name: RIWF E2 T-Maze confirmatory plan
environment: POBAX T-Maze (Bakker 2001, Tao et al. 2025) re-implemented in NumPy with the POBAX dynamics and rewards (4 correct, -0.1 wrong). Step limit four times the shortest path.
shift: source hallways uniform 5-10 per episode, target hallways 20, 40 and 80 in equal shares

pilots.gate: a quarter of candidates reach 0.9 source success, and target success at hallway 40 spans at least 0.3 across candidates
pilots.result: passed. GRU 8 and 128 and LSTM 32 at 300 updates solve hallway 80. Transformer window 8 solves source and fails at 20 and above. Window 32 solves 20 and fails at 40 and 80. GRU 32 at 150 updates reaches the junction on half the target episodes. A layer-norm initialisation bug that froze the transformers was found and fixed in the pilot.

pool: GRU and LSTM with hidden width 8, 32, 128 and a two-layer gated transformer with attention window 8 or 32, two seeds each, snapshots at updates 150 and 300: 32 candidates per world
memory: the feature the policy head reads at the first step at the junction
admission: a candidate is admitted when its native source success is within 0.10 of the best candidate in its world

panels.target: 128 unlabelled episodes per candidate and hallway length, rolled out by the candidate itself
panels.fresh: 200 episodes per candidate and hallway length, opened after the lock

teacher: set network with max pooling over the observation history, trained on labelled source histories up to the junction

selectors.fp3: min, P3 floor on own rollouts: 1 - reach + reach x linear-language freedom deficit at the junction memory
selectors.lin: min, linear-language freedom deficit on reached episodes only
selectors.tpe: max, teacher-based policy evaluation of the native actor

modes.refit: native movement, junction decision by the linear readout refitted on the panel with teacher labels, endpoint l_succ

hypotheses.H2: fp3 beats nat_val and each teacher-free selector on l_succ
hypotheses.H3: l_succ tracks 1 - fp3 with slope near 1, and fp3 selection beats kp3 selection
hypotheses.H4: tpe wins on n_succ and fp3 wins on l_succ
hypotheses.H8: zero-reward selection matches online validation at some n

stats.signflip: exact for 24 worlds or fewer, one million draws above
